programme.title: Fråga Gud - Hur ska vi klara livet?
programme.desc: Om du fick ställa en fråga till Gud vad skulle det vara då? Rigmor Holst med gäster ger svar på dina frågor.Gud visste ju när han gav oss en egen vilja att vi skulle spåra ur, då tänker jag. Hur tänkte han då och hur vi skulle klara av livet? Undrar Inga.Hårdrockaren Fredrik, undrar vad Gud har för musiksmak?

programme.title: Mysteriernas bok - Del 2
programme.desc: Mysteriernas Bok av Jonathan Cahn är baserad på hans bok med samma namn, och kan liknas med en skattkista fylld av mysterier, gömda nycklar och uppenbarelser. I denna serie får du chansen att ta del av bibliska mysterier från både Gamla och Nya Testamentet, mysterier som kan komma att förändra sättet du ser och läser bibeln på. Här får du inte bara svar på uråldriga frågor, men även kunskap och insikter i mysterier som ger dig både glädje och välsignelser.

programme.title: CBN 700 Club
programme.desc: Dagligt nyhetsprogram från Christian Broadcasting Network, USA. I programmet får du se nyhetsinlag och kommentarer men även vittnesbörd, intervjuer, promos och mycket mer; Allt med ett kristet perspektiv.

programme.title: BibelPodden - Davids fem stenar
programme.desc: Bibeln väcker ofta följdfrågor. Ett exempel: Varför väljer David ut just fem stenar från bäcken när han går för att möta jätten Goliat? Hur lång var Goliat egentligen? Skulle den bibliska berättelsen kunna fångas just i de fem stenar som David lägger i fickan på sin herdeväska? Och vad - eller vem - framträder som hörnsten i det stora bibliska byggnadsverket? Men allra först får du höra vad Per och Malin finner i de slumpvis utvalda bibelverser de fick med att fundera över från senaste avsnittet.

programme.title: Bokhyllan - Peter Ek - Del 1 av 2
programme.desc: Lennart Åsbergs programserie Bokhyllan är ett inspirerande program fyllt med böcker. Lennart välkomnar gäster för att samtala kring böcker av alla dess slag och former. Gästerna är en blandad kompott av författare, pastorer och ledare, men även vanliga människor som alla älskar att läsa böcker. Gäst är Peter Ek.

programme.title: Fråga Gud - Hur ska vi klara livet?
programme.desc: Om du fick ställa en fråga till Gud vad skulle det vara då? Rigmor Holst med gäster ger svar på dina frågor.Gud visste ju när han gav oss en egen vilja att vi skulle spåra ur, då tänker jag. Hur tänkte han då och hur vi skulle klara av livet? Undrar Inga.Hårdrockaren Fredrik, undrar vad Gud har för musiksmak?

programme.title: Uppdrag Guds rike - Stefan Gustavsson - Är Gud bortom tanke And språk?
programme.desc: Undervisning från konferensen Uppdrag Guds rike med Simon Johansson, Stefan Gustavsson, Andy Bannister, Joel MacInnes, Olof Edsinger och Per Ewert.Undervisning från konferensen Uppdrag Guds rike med Stefan Gustavsson, direktor Apologia.

programme.title: Letters - Daniel Stoor
programme.desc: I ett kreativt brev som läses upp till musik och bild delar människor sitt vittnesbörd om hur Jesus förvandlat deras liv från mörker till ljus.

programme.title: Träffpunkten - Kan en kristen ha onda andar i sig?
programme.desc: Välkommen till Träffpunkten, ett samtalsprogram som kommer ha högaktuella ämnen med mycket intressanta gäster, vi kommer beröra ämnen som vad är kristen tro? vad är bön? Hur lovsjunger vi Gud?.Träffpunkten, ett samtalprogram för Sverige i tiden.

programme.title: Den stora keramikkampen
programme.desc: Tävlingen är halvvägs och de åtta kvarstående keramikerna får utmaningar som reser sig i höjden. Domarna ber amatörkeramikerna bygga en gargouille, en mytisk och ståtlig vattenkastare för hand. I den andra uppgiften skapas toppen av en skorsten.

programme.title: Stilla havet
programme.desc: Vi besöker ett vidsträckt öppet hav som täcker halva vår planet. Det stora blå är hem för gigantiska djur som navigerar tusentals mil mellan ställen att äta på och ställen där de kan föda upp sina ungar.

programme.title: Kampen om Atlanten
programme.desc: Efter ett hemligt möte i Casablanca höjs insatserna när de allierade planerar inför D-dagen. Man behöver kontroll över Atlanten för att säkert få fram trupper, fordon och vapen till Storbritannien. Misslyckade bombangrepp på ubåtsbaser och de psykiska påfrestningarna för dem som kämpat till havs leder fram till en blodig konfrontation i maj 1943 som blir en vändpunkt i slaget om Atlanten.

programme.title: Utan karta i Ultevis
programme.desc: Finns det någon vildmark i Sverige? Och hur ser naturen ut där man är längst bort från vägar och vandringsleder? Det frågar sig filmaren Johan Granstrand och vildmarksguiden Sebastian Fall när de lämnar karta, GPS och telefoner bakom sig och ger sig in i Ultevis fjällurskog för att uppleva Sveriges kanske sista vildmark. Men gränsen mellan mänskliga spår och orörd natur visar sig vara svårare att dra än de trott och den äkta vildmarken är kanske mer ett tillstånd att försätta sig i än en plats att besöka.

programme.title: Mannen som räddar björnar
programme.desc: Kan de lösa sina konflikter inom flocken och komma till ro? Isbjörnen Ewa får också sällskap av Flocke och Tala.

programme.title: Historiska apokalypser
programme.desc: Rom, en gång historiens mäktigaste imperium kollapsade år 476 e.Kr. Men var det verkligen folkvandringstiden som avslutade det? Vi avslöjar ett par djupare orsaker som farsoter och klimatförändringar.

programme.title: Ett enklare liv
programme.desc: Vid Atlasbergens fot möter Ben upp Dina och Mostafa, två före detta Kentuckybor som valde bort allt för den marockanska landsbygden. De är fast beslutna om att nå ett självförsörjande liv, men vägen dit är inte helt spikrak.

programme.title: Övergivna byggnader
programme.desc: Följ med till en palatslik ruin i Philadelphia med band till Titanic-katastrofen och Hitlers högkvarter i Frankrike - en avlägsen utpost som hotade miljontals liv. Och i Polen ligger ett lantligt palats där det planerades en romantisk fälla för att snärja Napoleon.

programme.title: Historiska mysterier
programme.desc: Kleopatra förändrade historiens gång, men inte bara för Egypten - utan för hela romarriket. Hon har kallats ett politiskt geni efter sina allianser med Julius Caesar och Marcus Antonius. Men vem var hon som person, som en av dåtidens mäktigaste kvinnor? Och hur dog hon?

programme.title: På resa med Bachstad: Japan
programme.desc: Den sista sträckan bjuder på startsvårigheter och höjdskräck, samtidigt som Rune blir en stjärna på Shikokus stora trumfestival.

programme.title: Ikoniska byggnader
programme.desc: När vi tänker på en stads avgörande egenskaper är det oftast inte förorterna eller kontorskvarteren vi kommer att tänka på. Det är de platser där människor samlas - de stora torgen, monumenten, parkerna och byggnader av stor kulturell betydelse.

programme.title: Övergivna byggnader
programme.desc: Följ med till en palatslik ruin i Philadelphia med band till Titanic-katastrofen och Hitlers högkvarter i Frankrike - en avlägsen utpost som hotade miljontals liv. Och i Polen ligger ett lantligt palats där det planerades en romantisk fälla för att snärja Napoleon.

programme.title: Kinas oupptäckta natur
programme.desc: Kinas östra region är en av de mest tätbefolkade på jorden, men till och med här skapar människor plats för naturen. Några av de sällsynta djuren hittar en fristad i regionens fyra nya nationalparker.

programme.title: Jakten på jordens resurser
programme.desc: Från fossilbränslets uppsving under den industriella revolutionen följer vi utvecklingen och den snabba tillväxten av förnybara alternativ. Vind- och solkraftverk är exempel som växte fram oljekrisen på 70-talet. Här fördjupar vi oss i de händelser och processer som gjort att dessa två globala förnybara energisektorer blivit ledande aktörer.

programme.title: Italien med Stanley Tucci
programme.desc: Stanley finner sina rötter i Kalabrien, en vacker men historiskt orolig region i södra Italien. En släktträff blir en inspirerande och oförglömlig måltid. Del 6 av 8: Kalabrien.

programme.title: Dokument utifrån
programme.desc: Bin Ladin är död men kriget tar inte slut där. CIA stöttar kampen mot diktatorn i Syrien men inbördeskriget tillåter att Islamiska staten växer fram. Underrättelsetjänster världen över dras nu in i ett krig mot terrorn.

programme.title: Australiens orörda natur
programme.desc: De är de sanna australierna - röda kängurur. Som det största pungdjuret på jorden kan den täcka upp till 12 meter i ett enda hopp. I en miljö där människor dör av värmeslag efter några timmar, har kängurur framgångsrikt fostrat sina ungar i tusentals år - tack vare sin pung. Följ deras livsmiljö i Australiens eldiga hjärta - öknen.

programme.title: Rivalry in Music – Callas vs. Tebaldi
programme.desc: Maria Callas and Renata Tebaldi were the two most famous sopranos of the second half of the last century. Turned into hostile enemies by their admirers, the two became untouchable goddesses of opera. For their fans, Callas was known as the tigress, Tebaldi as the voice of an angel: the two singers could hardly have been more different, whether in their professional or private lives. To this day, Callas remains perhaps the greatest soprano of all time. Her rival, Tebaldi, is best known to opera lovers. Why is the posthumous fame of the two prima donnas so different?Subtitles available for this program with your remote control

programme.title: Rivalry in Music – Furtwängler vs. Toscanini
programme.desc: Two men without whom the profession of conductor would not be what it is today. Two men who couldn't be more different from each other: Arturo Toscanini and Wilhelm Furtwängler. The former was rigorously faithful to the musical score, the latter conducted with radical subjectivity. In 1931 they both conducted at the Bayreuth Festival – for the first and last time. Soon the polite rivalry turned into bitter enmity. Both men were forced to take a stand on the regimes in their respective countries – and chose radically different paths. Toscanini, the dictator, bravely challenged Mussolini; Furtwängler, a conservative, meanwhile proclaimed that art is always apolitical and reluctantly made a pact with the Nazis. The documentary not only opens up the different musical universes of the two great conductors by retracing their careers in Milan, Bayreuth and New York, but also raises a question that is more topical than ever: what has art to do with politics?Subtitles available for this program with your remote control

programme.desc: The FIM X-Trial World Championship is an international indoor motorcycle trials championship that features some of the best riders in the world competing in highly technical and challenging obstacle courses. In X-Trial events, riders navigate through a series of sections that include obstacles such as rocks, logs, and other challenging terrain, aiming to complete the course with the fewest penalties.

programme.title: FIM Enduro World Championship 2026
programme.desc: The FIM EnduroGP World Championship delivers thrilling off-road action, with top riders battling on challenging courses with natural obstacles. A packed schedule showcases skill and excitement.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The Audi RS6 Avant isn't a boring whip at all, seeing that Audi's Quattro GmbH get an output of 560hp out of the 4.2-liter V8 engine. But tuning company Meyer isn't satisfied enough. They turn the RS6 into the RS6 R Clubsport with an output of 811 hp and a sound similar to the rumble of thunder. The 'White Wolf' is visually aggressive as well. Stefan Kalläne is the man behind the extremely tuned Volkswagen Lupo. At the Tuning Expo in Saarbrücken he looks for the hottest gadgets of the tuning scene. Whether they are brutal, funny, useful or just very stylish - there is guaranteed to be something for everyone.

programme.title: Maailman kuolettavin meduusa
programme.desc: Meduusat voivat kasvaa sinivalaita pidemmiksi ja ovat eräs maailman vaarallisimmista olennoista. Niiden keho on yksinkertainen, mutta niitä on monenlaisia ja monen kokoisia. Niillä ei ole luita, hampaita tai aivoja, mutta ne kukoistavat muiden kuollessa. Niiden valta perustuu lonkeroihin, jotka ovat täynnä myrkkyä. 2 000 meduusalajista noin 70 on meille vaarallisia. Ne olivat eräs maailman ensimmäisistä elollisista olennoista ja saattavat olla viimeisenä elossa. Nämä ovat maailman vaarallisimmat meduusat.

Tohtori hoitaa ankkaa hädässä, ja aika on loppumassa, kun tamma on tukehtumassa. Charles ja Abigail pistäytyvät paikalle oman lemmikkinsä kanssa. Tohtori Nicole tutkii Eskien, jolla otti yhteen nelipyöräisen kanssa, ja Lisa ponnistelee lehmän ja sen vasikan pelastamiseksi.

programme.title: Syvänmeren tappajat

programme.desc: Meduusat voivat kasvaa sinivalaita pidemmiksi ja ovat eräs maailman vaarallisimmista olennoista. Niiden keho on yksinkertainen, mutta niitä on monenlaisia ja monen kokoisia. programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: Talvi on saapunut farmille, ja Polit tekevät lisäyksiä laumaansa! Perhe tuo farmille neljä merinouuhta, jotka on juuri astutettu, eli hyvällä tuurilla farmi saa ensimmäiset karitsansa keväällä. Kun talvi alkaa väistyä ja kevät saapuu, Polit valmistautuvat uusien tulokkaiden tuloon rakentamalla lampolaan karitsoimiskarsinan. Beth tarkistaa, ovatko mehiläiset selvinneet talvesta.

programme.title: Petojen salainen elämä
programme.desc: Jos olet metsän peto, onnistumisen takaamiseksi on käytettävä puita kuoleman ja elämän välisen kamppailun ratkaisemiseksi. Tässä valtakunnassa vaara – tai seuraava ateria – voi olla takana, alla tai yllä. Oli sitten kyseessä harpyija silmäilemässä sademetsän latvoista käsin saalista, nokkela näätä sukeltelemassa sammaleisten tukkien sisään ja niistä ulos tai bengalintiikeri vaanimassa saalista kuivassa ja paljaassa metsässä, saaliin nappaaminen puiden seassa on haaste.

programme.title: Petojen salainen elämä
programme.desc: Maailmalla saalistajien, jotka vaanivat avoimilla paikoilla, on piilouduttava kukoistaakseen. Afrikan savannin loppumattomilla tasangoilla seepramangustit luottavat joukon voimaan selviytyäkseen jättiläisten maassa.

programme.title: Afrikan kuolettava kuningaskunta

programme.title: Äärimmäinen saalistaja
programme.desc: Haihyökkäykset Brasilian rannikolla vahingoittavat kymmeniä. Siperian tiikerit vahingoittavat myös ihmisiä, mutta nälkä ei ole hyökkäysten syy. Uimarit saavat varoa, sillä Floridan alligaattorit syövät mitä tahansa. Syrjäinen puisto Ontariossa on eräs maailman kauneimmista retkeilymaisemista, mutta paikallinen mustakarhu johtaa tervetulokomiteaa.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Alkuperäiskansalainen ja kouluttaja Phil Breslin suuntaa Australian sademetsien jatkuvaan kuumuuteen, kosteuteen ja sateisiin selvittääkseen, mitä tarvitaan, jotta ihminen olisi ”rakennettu selviytymään”. Lehtimetsän latvustossa Phil kohtaa vaikeasti lähestyttävän puukengurun ja sen poikasen sekä Australian suurimman käärmeen, tappavan ametistipytonin. Metsänpohjalla värikäs kasuaari toimii sademetsän puutarhurina.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Alkuperäiskansalainen ja kasvattaja Phil Breslin tutkii Channel Countryn aavikoita ja etsii kolmea eläintä, jotka eivät vain selviä kuumuudessa vaan myös kukoistavat armottomissa olosuhteissa. Valmistaudu tapaamaan Australian vaikuttavimmat eläimet: suurvaraani, mantereen suurin lisko, emu, maanosan nopein lentokyvytön lintu, ja mahtava punainen kenguru, maailman suurin pussieläin.

programme.desc: Miekkavalas on maailman suurin delfiini: kymmenen metriä pitkä, ja se painaa jopa kuusi tonnia. Poikaset viettävät useita vuosia emonsa vierellä ja oppivat saalistamaan meren pienimpiä ja suurimpia eläimiä. Charles esittelee taaperotyttärelleen messujen kohokohdat. PVS:n tiimi on kiireinen vatsakipujen, mehiläisten pistojen ja vauvojen kanssa. programme.title: Härkähaiden salaisuudet
programme.desc: Tiedämme, että härkähait osaavat uida ylävirtaan, ja tiedämme, että ne saalistavat meressä, mutta emme ole koskaan nähneet kaikkea näin tarkkaan. Näemme, miten ne käyvät muiden haiden kimppuun ja syövät niitä. Seuraamme, miten ne metsästävät syvyyksissä. Seuraamme niitä lisääntymispaikoille makean veden jokiin. Näemme ylhäältä dronejen avulla, miten hait saalistavat kalaparvia ja ottavat yhteen virtahepojen ja krokotiilien kanssa.

programme.title: Tappajaeläimet
programme.desc: Minisarjan viidennellä kaudella tutustumme luonnon vaarallisimpiin saalistajiin: gepardiin, harmaakarhuun, miekkavalaaseen, leopardiin, suteen ja hyeenaan. (Lopullisella listalla on neljä eläintä.)

programme.title: Petojen salainen elämä
programme.desc: Vastapainona metsille maapallolla on paikkoja, joissa kedot, tundra ja jäiset maat jatkuvat silmänkantamattomiin joka suuntaan. Kun puita ei ole estämässä tuulta, lämpötilat ovat äärimmäisiä.

programme.title: Uskomaton eläinlääkäri Pol
programme.desc: Isabella County Fair -messut ovat vauhdissa! Tohtori Pol jatkaa epävirallisena messueläinlääkärinä auttaen lapsia pitämään maatilan elukat valmiina ja terveinä huutokauppaa varten. Charles esittelee taaperotyttärelleen messujen kohokohdat. PVS:n tiimi on kiireinen vatsakipujen, mehiläisten pistojen ja vauvojen kanssa. Lisäksi tohtori Nicole hoitaa Shih Tzun silmään liittyvän hätätilanteen.

programme.title: Uskomaton eläinlääkäri Pol
programme.desc: Tri Polilla ja tiimillä on paljon potilaita. Chihuahuat, chinchillat ja monet muut otukset pitävät PVS:n eläinlääkärit varpaillaan aamusta yöhön.

programme.title: Afrikan kuolettava kuningaskunta
programme.desc: Afrikan vaarallinen valtakunta: Riutoilla, aaltojen alla paljastuvat merenelävien uskomattomat muuntautumiskyvyt.

programme.title: Petojen salainen elämä
programme.desc: Metsästäjien on erikoistuttava, kehitettävä yllättäviä strategioita ja näytettävä uskomatonta voimaa. Näkemyksemme joistain maailman tunnetuimmista saalistajista käännetään ylösalaisin. Saamme myös tavata muutaman uuden yllättävän lihansyöjän.

programme.title: Kesyttämättömät Filippiinit
programme.desc: Lähdemme liikkeelle pieneltä Batanin saarelta. Tapaamme ainutlaatuisen kyyn ja kaikkialla viihtyvän jättimäisen ravun.

programme.title: Alaskan kalasodat
programme.desc: Alaskan kalasodat

programme.title: Eurooppa ylhäältä päin
programme.desc: Eurooppa ylhäältä vie meidät yli Saksan, Italian, Alankomaiden, Puolan, Espanjan ja Yhdistyneen kuningaskunnan näyttääkseen Euroopan hienoimpia kohteita. Upea ilmakuvaus näyttää kausivaihtelut sekunneissa, kun tulppaanipellot Alankomaissa puhkeavat värien juhlaan ja Dolomiittien vesiputoukset jäätyvät. Paljastamme, miten perinteet, insinööritaidot ja luonnonihmeet ovat muovanneet upeaa mannerta.

programme.title: IQFOiL International Games
programme.desc: More than 150 athletes from 18 different countries competed in Cadiz for one of the most coveted titles of this class: the second stop of the International Circuit of the IQ Foil class. After the meeting in Lanzarote, some of the best windsurfers in the world meet again in Cadiz to compete in the International Games IQ Foil Cadiz. Enjoy the competition in Cadiz!

programme.title: The Ocean Race
programme.desc: Welcome to the exciting world of the Ocean Race! If you are a lover of sailing and racing, you can't miss the Nautical Channel's summary programmes of this incredible, high-octane regatta, which takes place over several months across the world's oceans.Follow the most prestigious teams and the most experienced sailors as they compete in a series of legs around the world, in a test of physical and mental endurance that tests their skills and abilities in the most difficult and challenging conditions of the open seas.With our Ocean Race highlights, you can enjoy the thrill of this elite competition from the comfort of your own home, without missing a single detail of the battle for first place.Don't miss out and join us in this adventure at sea!

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: The island of Ugljan, right across the town of Zadar, is known for its olives and olive produce. Beautiful sandy beaches and crystal clear sea will take your breath away. Smaller island of the Zadar archipelago like Ist and Silba looks like frozen in time and are really great for escaping from civilization.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: Small islands of Zadar archipelago are very popular for sailing and we will show you why. The town of Zadar was founded in Roman times and by every step through it you will stumble upon amazing heritage from the ancient times. Of course, we couldn't resist and we visited crazy funny Museum of Illusions.

programme.title: Surfer's Blood
programme.desc: Renowned surf photographer and filmmaker Patrick Trefz explores the essence of the sport he loves by profiling those who inspire him. Surfers' Blood tells the universal story of true individuals that share deep bloodlines connected to the sea.From wooden fishing boats in the Basque Country coast with oar and surfboard shaper Patxi Oliden to the metropolis of San Francisco and the eccentric computer shapes of Apple fame designer Thomas Meyerhoffer, unique people unite by a deep connection to the sea.Watch it on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Welcome to Kite Masters!The series that flies you around the world, together with the very best athletes from one of the fastest, most extreme and stylish sports: kiteboarding. For some people kiteboarding is a hobby, for others it’s a performance, but for many it’s life.We bring the most passionate athletes experience inside the sport to the screen. We’ll take a look back over all the happenings earlier this season in the extreme world of kiteboarding, and the transformation of the sport on the road to Paris 2024.Follow these pro athletes on their journey to become the best in their fields and their evolution throughout the years. Now available, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: Markkleeberg, in Germany, is home to the Pleisse River that runs through the city. Known for merging several towns over the years, it now combines the best athletes who compete in the Slalom World Cup.Watch the most extreme canoe slalom that will decide the world champion in this unique 2021 Markkleeberg competition.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: Prague hosts the 2021 Slalom World Cup, and the top class athletes are getting ready for a weekend full of action. They will have to pass through a combination of upstream and downstream gates in the fastest time possible, however the competition will prove to be hard as only the best will be in this event.Watch the Slalom World Cup competition that is taking place in Prague.

programme.title: What Sup
programme.desc: Welcome to the second episode of What SUP. On today's episode, comedian Ryan Maglunob and the band the Elwins will join us in our adventures. Chris first saw Ryan perform live a few months ago, and he was amused throughout the whole set. Let's go take a paddle with Ryan before playing paddle pong and many other challenges!

programme.title: Torrevieja Euromarina Optimist International Trophy
programme.desc: The Torrevieja Euromarina Optimist International Trophy is a scoring regatta for the Optimist Excellence Cup, the international event that this year has achieved a record participation with 406 sailors from 27 countries. High level sailing meets in Torrevieja, which hosts the third round of the Optimist Excellence Cup (OEC) 2021-2022 after its previous stops in Vigo and El Puerto de Santa María. With four days of competition and a total of 12 races planned, we can expect an excellent competition to unwind in Torrevieja, Spain. After previous cancelations due to COVID, this season is filled with excitement and action in the four regattas that conform the OEC. With its international scope, it drives the attention of sailors worldwide for a record attendance. Enjoy the competition in Torrevieja for the Euromarina Optimist International Trophy.

programme.title: Surf The Alps
programme.desc: Despite being nestled in the heart of the Swiss Alps, Lake Zurich is home to a wealth of water sports. Journalist Lucia Metzbauer wakeboards with Swiss pros, attends the annual match race, and even tries stand-up paddleboarding before discovering a little-known sport: kanupolo.Also, the International Wakeboard Competition of Züri Fäscht 2013 is taking place in the centre of Zurich, and athletes are ready for Switzerland's greatest freestyle competition in this class. Let's dive into it!

programme.title: Surf Ski
programme.desc: Welcome to Durban! The Surf Ski World Tour is reaching its end, and standing at the pinnacle of the sport, the best open ocean paddlers from around the worlds reunite to take part in it. Jasper Mocké has proved to be in shape all season, but we have seen other important names raise to the top. Discover the exciting world of surf ski on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: Szeged, the third biggest city in Hungary has been chosen once again for the International Canoe Federation Sprints World Cup. Athletes from all over the world are ready to prove their skills over the C2, K1, K2 categories. The event will prove to be hard as most of the athletes have been training for the Olympic Games.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: Barnaul, in Russia is a city to the west of the Ob River. This is one of the major rivers in Russia and home to the second stage of the Sprint World Cup. Despite the cold windy morning, more than 3000 people have assisted to watch athletes give their all in this competition.Watch the competition at Barnaul that concluded with the 5K challenge.

programme.title: Dusi Canoe Marathon
programme.desc: The three-day event of the FNB Dusi Canoe Marathon is back again for the 2016 edition. Participants competing for the podium will have to trust their partners, be the best at route scouting and keep their focus until the very last moment, a task that is not easy at all. Both mental and physical preparation play a crucial part in one of the toughest paddling competitions. Relive the best moments of the 2016 edition of the Dusi Canoe Marathon.

programme.title: Unomattina
programme.desc: Un racconto della realtà con un taglio di maggiore approfondimento. Dai temi più caldi come il lavoro, l'occupazione, l'economia e i consumi, si affrontano anche tematiche legate alla salute e agli stili di vita. programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Glenn Wagner veranstaltet für seine Freundin Amy Lansing eine Scheidungsparty. Inmitten der fröhlichen Ausgelassenheit zieht er an einer Angelsehne. Daraufhin öffnet sich im eigens für diesen Anlass errichteten Hochzeitspavillon eine Falltür, und Amys Ex-Ehemann fällt mit einer Schlinge um den Hals heraus. Wagner gibt an, dass sich auf dem Dachboden des Pavillons anstelle des Mannes eine Puppe befunden habe.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Eine tote Flugbegleiterin fällt blutüberströmt auf das Förderband der Gepäckausgabe. Wie sich herausstellt, hatte Suzanne Grady ein Verhältnis mit einem Piloten. Der gibt zu, sich mit Suzanne in einem Ruheraum vergnügt zu haben. Bei der Vernehmung einer Kollegin des Opfers stoßen die Ermittler auf ein neues Motiv: Neid. Denn ihre Kollegin hatte Suzanne am Vorabend betrunken gemacht, damit die einen Flug verpasst und bestraft wird.

programme.title: Der Blaulicht Report - Einzeleinsätze
programme.desc: Ob Raubüberfall, Brandstiftung oder hilflose Personen - die Arbeit von Polizisten, Notärzten und Rettungssanitätern erfordert nicht nur Sachkenntnis, sondern auch Einfühlungsvermögen und Durchsetzungskraft. programme.title: CSI: Den Tätern auf der Spur
programme.desc: In den Bergen wird ein Toter gefunden, dem mit chirurgischer Präzision die Organe entfernt wurden.

programme.title: Deutschland am Morgen
programme.desc: Dein Morgen, dein Rhythmus: Deutschland am Morgen von RTL und ntv ist der tägliche Begleiter für alle, die bestens informiert und gut unterhalten in den Tag starten wollen. Von 6 bis 9 Uhr liefert das Nachrichtenmagazin die wichtigsten Themen und ordnet sie verständlich ein. Ob Politik, Wirtschaft, Sport oder Service: Feste Rubriken und spannende Talks sorgen für den richtigen Takt am Morgen.

programme.title: Gute Zeiten, schlechte Zeiten
programme.desc: Toni will nach vorn sehen. Doch die Lügen der Vergangenheit haften an ihr. Gerners Freude über Johannas Rückkehr aus Hongkong wird getrübt, als diese ihm ihre neu ausgearbeiteten Pläne für die Integration des Jugendclubs in den KI-Hub vorstellt. Als Gerner heraushört, dass sie sich dazu mit Jonas beraten hat, fürchtet er, dass Johanna die Interessen der Bank aus den Augen verliert. Aber er will auch nicht erneut mit seiner Tochter streiten ...

programme.title: Unter uns
programme.desc: Ringo greift zu unfairen Methoden, um Ute zu schaden, doch Benedikt will aus Loyalität zu ihr einen Weg finden, seinen Sohn aufzuhalten. Naomi freut sich auf ihre neue Stelle als Assistentin von Patrizia, weiß jedoch nicht, wie sie Paco und Britta davon erzählen soll. Baris ist von seinen Gefühlen für Larissa überwältigt und beschließt, sie nicht länger auszuspionieren, was ihn jedoch in eine gefährliche Lage bringen könnte.

programme.title: Ulrich Wetzel - Das Strafgericht
programme.desc: Hanna Knobloch soll bei ihrer jüngeren Schwester Silvia Geller eingebrochen sein und sie brutal niedergeschlagen haben. Hintergrund der Tat ist das Erbstück ihrer verstorbenen Mutter: ein Oldtimer.

programme.title: Barbara Salesch - Das Strafgericht
programme.desc: Wolf Francke wird beschuldigt, das Haus seines ehemaligen Freundes Stefan Urbanschek aus Rache angezündet zu haben, nachdem dieser ihn wegen Unterschlagung gemeldet hatte. Auch Stefan selbst gerät ins Visier der Ermittler.

programme.title: Punkt 12 - Das RTL-Mittagsjournal
programme.desc: Aktuelle Informationen, Servicethemen, jede Menge Lifestyle und das Neueste aus der Welt der Prominenten - das ist nur die eine Seite von Punkt 12. Darüber hinaus gibt es täglich spannende und ausführliche Reportagen und Mini-Dokus, die je nach Blickwinkel verblüffende, schrille oder schockierende Einblicke in den Alltag der Deutschen geben.

programme.title: Barbara Salesch - Das Strafgericht
programme.desc: Tobias Seiler, Gärtner bei Frank Busse, wird beschuldigt, die Ehefrau seines Arbeitgebers im Schlaf ermordet zu haben. Die Tat geschah aus Eifersucht, da Tobias eine Affäre mit der Ermordeten hatte, die kurz vor ihrem Tod beendet wurde.

programme.title: Ulrich Wetzel - Das Strafgericht
programme.desc: Isabell Ott soll ihre Putzhilfe Eva Kessler hinterrücks niedergeschlagen haben. Die mittellose 38-Jährige drohte wegen der Schikanen von Isabell mit Kündigung. Außerdem hütet Eva ein brisantes Geheimnis ihrer Chefin. Wollte die Angeklagte Isabell Ott ihre Putzhilfe deshalb zum Schweigen bringen? Richter Ulrich Wetzel findet im Verlauf der Verhandlung heraus, dass auch Isabells Sohn Aaron etwas verschweigt...

programme.title: Ulrich Wetzel - Das Jugendgericht
programme.desc: David Rode ist Fahrlehrer mit Leib und Seele und bei allen sehr beliebt. Nach einer Fahrstunde mit seiner Schülerin Vivien Trapp wird David plötzlich von hinten angegriffen und mit einem Messer verletzt. Hat Vivian etwas damit zu tun?

programme.title: Unter uns
programme.desc: Easy ringt mit der Frage, ob er Ringo verraten soll, da dieser gegenüber der Familie skrupellos handelt. Anna schöpft Hoffnung auf einen Neuanfang, doch ein erneuter Rückschlag trifft sie hart. Baris entscheidet sich, Larissa gegenüber ehrlich zu sein und sie nicht länger auszuspionieren, doch Esma hat eine andere Sichtweise und könnte seine Pläne durchkreuzen.

programme.title: Explosiv - Das Magazin
programme.desc: Aktuell, mitreißend und gefährlich ehrlich - das ist Deutschlands beliebtestes tägliches Boulevard-Magazin. Explosiv präsentiert die Geschichten, die Deutschland bewegen und regelmäßig für öffentliche Diskussionen sorgen. Das RTL-Magazin knüpft immer dort an, wo die Geschichten der Menschen hinter den News beginnen und beweist, dass Boulevard deutlich mehr ist als nur Sensationsjournalismus.

programme.title: Exclusiv - Das Starmagazin
programme.desc: Wo ein roter Teppich ausgerollt wird, ist Exclusiv nicht weit. Täglich liefert Deutschlands erfolgreichstes Starmagazin die aktuellsten Promi-News, verrät die heißesten Gerüchte und gibt Einblicke in das Leben der angesagtesten Celebrities dieser Welt. Von Hollywood bis Berlin, von royalen Hochzeiten bis zu privaten Glücksmomenten - Exclusiv berichtet zuverlässig und aktuell aus der Welt der Stars und Sternchen.

programme.title: RTL Aktuell
programme.desc: Im Vordergrund der Hauptnachrichtensendung RTL Aktuell stehen die Themen, die wirklich relevant für die Zuschauer sind. Welche Auswirkungen haben politische Entscheidungen, wirtschaftliche Entwicklungen, soziale Trends und Innovationen wie zum Beispiel medizinische Neuerungen auf ihr Leben? programme.title: CSI: New York
programme.desc: Die 22-jährige Jenny Lee wird mit aufgeschnittener Kehle in einer Wäscherei gefunden. Die Leiche war in einem Laken des Dunsmore Hotels eingewickelt, in dem zurzeit der ausländische Diplomat Robert Costa und sein Gefolge residieren. Mac findet Hinweise darauf, dass Jenny in Costas Suite mit dem Schlafmittel Rohypnol betäubt wurde, doch Costa kann nicht der Täter gewesen sein, denn er hatte ebenfalls von dem mit Rohypnol versetzten Champagner getrunken. Das CSI-Team nimmt Costa, seinen Sicherheitschef Tony Garcia, seinen Referatsleiter Frank Barret und seinen Fahrer Tom Martin genauer unter die Lupe und entdeckt, dass der Schlüssel zur Lösung des Falls in einem über zehn Jahre zurückliegenden Verbrechen zu finden ist: Damals war die Studentin Susan Young auf die gleiche Weise ermordet worden, und Costa stand unter Verdacht. Auf Garcias, Martins und Barrets Aussagen hin wurde Costa jedoch freigesprochen. Wollte jemand Costa mit seiner Vergangenheit konfrontieren? Und wer ist dieser Jemand? Danny und Aiden untersuchen den Tod eines Straßenkünstlers. Als menschliche Statue hatte er Tag für Tag stundenlang bewegungslos auf dem Gehsteig gestanden und von den Spenden der Passanten gelebt - bis er plötzlich aus unerfindlichen Gründen tot umgekippt war. Hawkes bescheinigt eine natürliche Todesursache, doch Danny kommen die Umstände merkwürdig vor. Er ermittelt entgegen Macs Anweisungen weiter und fördert dabei Unglaubliches zu Tage: Der Tote war der Obdachlose John Hawkins, der erst nach seinem Ableben kostümiert und als menschliche Staue aufgestellt wurde. Vähitellen Oskarille selviää, että Eli on vampyyri, jonka on juotava toisten verta selviytyäkseen. Oskarin on päätettävä mitä hän on valmis hyväksymään...

programme.title: Ormens väg på hälleberget (16)
programme.desc: Kertomus köyhästä leskestä, Teasta, jonka on pakko maksaa maanvuokransa luonnossa. Elokuva on kertomus 1800-luvun köyhän Ruotsin fyysisestä ja psyykkisestä ahdingosta. Bo Widerbergin klassikkoelokuva perustuu Torgny Lindgrenin romaaniin.

programme.title: Mies, joka lopetti tupakoimisen (12)
programme.desc: Komedia ketjupolttaja Dantesta (Gösta Ekman), joka saa periä 17 miljoonaa kruunua isältään, jos lopettaa tupakoimisen 14 päivän sisällä.

programme.title: Hamilton - kansakunnan puolesta (16)
programme.desc: Ruotsalainen toimintatrilleri perustuu Jan Guilloun romaaniin. Mikael Persbrandt esittää erityisagentti Carl Hamiltonia.

programme.title: Bröderna Karlsson (12)
programme.desc: Karlssonin veljekset ovat kaksosia, mutta eivät tiedä toistensa olemassaolosta. Yksi on menestynyt ja tarkka lakimies Tukholmassa ja toinen vetelä vilunki pohjoisesta. Veljekset kohtaavat toisensa perunkirjoituksessa, ja seuraukset mullistavat molempien elämän.

programme.title: Eva And Adam - neljät synttärit ja fiasko (S)
programme.desc: Eva ja Adam ovat 14-vuotiaita, mutta ovat olleet yhdessä jo 3 vuotta. Eva kuitenkin päättää lopettaa suhteen. Adam on epätoivoinen, mutta onnistuu pysymään rauhallisena. Eva haluaa Adamin takaisin, kun uusi tyttö kiinnostuu tästä.

programme.title: Lapin poliisit
programme.desc: Luontoäiti. Vaihtelevat sääolosuhteet vaikeuttavat poliisin moottorikelkkakoulutusta Käsivarren erämaassa. Sodankylässä löydetään nuori mies muuttopuuhissa keskellä yötä. #lapinpoliisit

programme.title: Lapin poliisit
programme.desc: Myrskyisä Vappu. Rovaniemellä häiriökäyttäytymiset ja riidat aiheuttavat kiirettä partiolle. Inarissa poliisi järjestää erävalvontaiskun, jota uhkaa yöllä riehunut myrsky. #lapinpoliisit

programme.title: Melkein MENSA
programme.desc: Koomikot Joonas Nordman ja Fathi Ahmed sekä näyttelijä Kari ”Hissu” Hietalahti kisaavat Suomen turhimman tietovisan voitosta. Teemoina äidinkieli ja keskiaika. Vakiokapteenina Eero Ritala, Juha Perälä pisteyttää ja rankaisee.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer And Budapest Festival Orchestra - Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók’s best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta. Remarkable is the work’s instrumentation: Bartók divided the strings into two groups that are placed on opposite sides of the stage, to create antiphonal effects. The program ends with Brahms’s Symphony No. 3 in F major, Op. 90. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on December 4, 2017.

programme.title: Mark Perna - Modena - The Belcanto School
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Martha Argerich, Herbert Blomstedt And Lucerne Festival Orchestra - Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1 And Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. The celebrated pianist performs this signature piece at the Lucerne Festival with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who makes his festival debut with the orchestra. Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36, is also on the program. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Roberto Prosseda - Mozart - Piano Sonata No. 13, KV 333
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn. Since 2012, Prosseda also gives lecture-concerts with the robot pianist TeoTronico, as educational or family concerts, to demonstrate differences between a literal production of music and human interpretation.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle, London Symphony Orchestra, Magdalena Kožená And Andrew Staples - Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra in Gustav Mahler’s poignant song cycle ‘Das Lied von der Erde’ (The Song of the Earth). Joining him are two of today's leading vocalists: mezzo-soprano Magdalena Kožená and tenor Andrew Staples. Written in the final years of his life, Mahler’s masterpiece contemplates the beauty of life and the sorrow of parting through some of his most personal and beautiful symphonic writing. Written in the final years of his life and following the tragic death of his daughter, Mahler wrestles with the transience of life, contrasting moments of vivacity and happiness with introspection and melancholy. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on May 9, 2021.

programme.title: Daniel Harding - Brahms - Tragic Overture in D minor Op. 81
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival. As part of the festival’s 2021 edition, maestro Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program featuring Johannes Brahms’s Tragic Overture in D minor, Op. 81, and Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’. Brahms composed his concert overture during the summer of 1880. With its dark and tumultuous character, it could be regarded as the serious counterpart of his more joyful Academic Festival Overture, Op. 80. Mahler completed his first symphony eight years later, in 1888. Originally a five-movement piece, the composer discarded the second movement ‘Blumine’ some years later, resulting in the final four-movement version we know today. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt And Gewandhausorchester Leipzig - Symphonies in D by Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig’s Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek’s Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek’s only symphony – was never performed during the composer’s lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Schumann - Fantasiestücke Op. 73
programme.desc: In Geneva, the city where she spent the most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play in private chamber music. Between each piece, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit, in an intimate interview that brings both their intimacy and the music. On the program are Ludwig van Beethoven’s 7 variations after The Magic Flute; Robert Schumann’s Fantasiestücke, Op. 73; Frédéric Chopin’s Introduction And Polonaise, Op. 3; ‘Lerchengesang’ (No. 2) from Johannes Brahms’s 4 Gesänge, Op. 70; and ‘Largo’ from Chopin’s Cello Sonata in G minor, Op. 65. This broadcast was recorded on November 12 and 13, 2020, in Geneva, Switzerland.

programme.title: Max Emanuel Cencic, Philippe Jaroussky, Andreas Scholl And Franco Fagioli - Heavenly Voices - The legacy of Farinelli
programme.desc: The documentary 'Heavenly Voices – The Legacy of Farinelli' (2012) tells us the story of the castrato in music – male singers who were castrated at a young age in order to preserve their high vocal range, a cruel practice that was in place mainly in the 17th and 18th centuries. For two centuries, castrati's performances held European audiences spellbound, with successful castrati such as Farinelli ranking among the most influential and highest-earning musicians of those days. Today, roles originally written for castrati are often performed by countertenors. In this documentary, countertenors Max Emanuel Cenčić, Philippe Jaroussky, Andreas Scholl, Franco Fagioli, and Jochen Kowalski discuss Baroque-era operatic entertainment. 'Heavenly Voices' is a film by Gino Pennacchi (writer) and Alessandro Scillitani (director).

programme.title: Roberto Prosseda - Mozart - Piano Sonata No. 5, KV 283
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn. Since 2012, Prosseda also gives lecture-concerts with the robot pianist TeoTronico, as educational or family concerts, to demonstrate differences between a literal production of music and human interpretation.

programme.title: Václav Luks And Collegium 1704 - Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Trio Michelangeli And Erinys Quartet - Chamber music by Haydn, Chausson And Mendelssohn
programme.desc: Discover the next generation of chamber music talent from the Reina Sofía School of Music. In the first half of this program, Trío Michelangeli presents two masterpieces: Joseph Haydn’s Piano Trio No. 39 in G major, nicknamed ‘Gypsy’, followed by the romanticism of Ernest Chausson’s Piano Trio in G minor. The concert concludes with a performance by the Erinys Quartet of Felix Mendelssohn’s inventive String Quartet No. 2 in A minor.

programme.title: Touring Club Italiano - Teatro Regio behind the scenes
programme.desc: Few Italian theatres can boast of being an absolute point of reference for national and world culture. The Teatro Regio in Turin is both a symbol of excellence in the national operatic tradition and a prestigious stage hosting operas, ballets, concerts, and musicals of great substance. This short documentary offers a behind-the-scenes tour of the Teatro Regio Torino and bears witness to the enviable reputation that has prevailed since its opening in 1740.

programme.title: Gustavo Dudamel - De Falla - El sombrero de tres picos - Suite No. 2
programme.desc: During the New Year’s Gala 2010, the Berlin Philharmonic perform under the baton of Gustavo Dudamel, whose infectious energy and exceptional artistry have made him one of the most sought-after conductors by orchestras and opera companies around the world. They welcome mezzo-soprano Elīna Garanča, who has become one of the world’s most famous singers within just a few years. On the program are various works by French composers, like Berlioz’ Le Carnival Romain, Overture, Op. 9 and D’Amour l’ardente flamme’ from La Damnation de Faust (Op. 24), Saint-Saëns’ ‘Mon cœur s’ouvre à ta voix’ and ‘Danse Bacchanale’ from his opera Samson et Dalila and the ‘Habanera’, ‘Seguidilla’ and ‘Chanson Bohème’ from Bizet’s Carmen. The concert concludes with de Falla’s Suite No. 2 from the ballet ‘El sombrero de tres picos’.

programme.title: Lukáš Vondráček, Michael Tilson Thomas And London Symphony Orchestra - Liszt’s Concerto No. 1 And Mahler’s Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: Michael Tilson Thomas conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Mahler’s Fifth Symphony. Lukáš Vondráček is the soloist in Liszt’s First Piano Concerto. Recorded on May 15th, 2022.

programme.title: Andreas Spering And philharmonie zuidnederland - Schubert - Overture to Rosamunde (D. 644)
programme.desc: Andreas Spering conducts Philharmonie Zuidnederland in a performance of Overture Rosamunde (D. 644), by Franz Schubert (1797-1828). Recorded in Muziekgebouw Eindhoven, the Netherlands in 2015. Schubert initially composed the Overture for Georg Ernst von hofmann's play 'Die Zauberharfe' ('The Magic Harp'), which premiered on August 19, 1820. Three years later, the overture was used again, this time for Helmina von Chézy's play Rosemunde. Chézy's (1783-1856) librettos enjoyed little succes, and it is said that Schubert's contribution to Rosamunde saved the production.

programme.title: Ballet du Capitole de Toulouse - Toulouse-Lautrec
programme.desc: Dance was a central component in the work of Toulouse-Lautrec, a painter of Parisian parties, music halls, circuses and balls. To the melodies and rhythms of Bruno Coulais, the choreographer Kader Belarbi takes inspiration from his work for a new dialogue between painting and dance.

programme.title: Vadim Repin And Murad Huseynov - Gara Garayev : Autumn Sonatas
programme.desc: Pianist Vadim Repin and Violist Murad Hüseynov perform Gara Garayev's Violin Sonata and 24 Preludes for Piano. Recorded at La Grange ay Lac. Written and directed by Juliette Swierczewski and recorded at La Grange au Lac. Although Garayev is a 20th century composer, his music nonetheless carries allusions to romantic music. Murad, the main actor, will represent one of those characters carried by solitude that can be found in the romantic paintings of Friedrich. The overall atmosphere of the musical program is rather melancholic, tending either towards a certain musical lightness, or, on the contrary, towards drama. The production is a cinematographic accompaniment of the music and its performers.

programme.title: Andreas Spering And philharmonie zuidnederland - Beethoven - Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: Conducted by Andreas Spering, the South Netherlands Philharmonic performs Beethoven’s Sixth Symphony. Ludwig van Beethoven painted in his symphony the rustic idylls of a peasants’ picnic in the countryside, rife with murmuring brooks and a frightful thunderstorm. It was destined to become one of his most regularly performed symphonies. In this work too, Beethoven composed with a revolutionary and innovative verve. An excellent opportunity to listen to music with late eighteenth and early nineteenth century ears.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 3, Op. 14
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birthday, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. The Third Piano Sonata, Op. 14 (also called Concerto for piano without orchestra by Tobias Haslinger) was composed in 1836 and dedicated to Ignaz Moscheles. In 1853 Schumann revised the work and added a Scherzo as a second movement. The final movement is reminiscent of Kreisleriana, Op. 16. Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has had the privilege of performing as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, among them Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto And Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería - Prokofiev - Peter and the Wolf
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Sergei Prokofiev’s Peter and the Wolf, Op. 67. Written in 1936, Peter and the Wolf is a short, narrated orchestral suite, telling the story of a brave boy named Peter, who lives with his grandfather on the edge of a forest. With the help of his animal friends, Peter outsmarts a villainous wolf and captures it, eventually leading it to the zoo. Maestro Prieto gives an introduction to the different parts of the suite. In each part, each character is represented by a different instrument or instrument section, offering a vivid introduction to the orchestra's instrumental families. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Nacional in Mexico City, in 2021.

programme.title: Sir John Eliot Gardiner - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra And Víkingur Ólafsson - Welser-Möst conducts Farrenc, Ravel And Mussorgsky
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Philippe Jordan And Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris - Beethoven - Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68, also known as the Pastoral Symphony. Beethoven wrote the work upon completion of his Symphony No. 5. Both symphonies premiered at the same legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 6 consists of five movements, of which the last three are played without a break. Each movement carries a title that suggests a scene from life in the countryside. The joyful atmosphere of the first three movements is interrupted by the violent fourth movement ‘Thunder, Storm’, as expressed by the piccolos, brass, and timpani. As the storm recedes at the end of the movement, the tranquility returns in the final movement. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Christian Zacharias - Schumann - Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a performance of Robert Schumann’s Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony’. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann’s four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: David Grimal - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Gotthold Schwarz, Thomanerchor Leipzig, Gewandhausorchester Leipzig And Dorothee Mields - J. S. Bach – Christmas Oratorio, BWV 248
programme.desc: Traditionally, many ensembles festively announce the Christmas season with a performance of Johannes Sebastian Bach’s Christmas Oratorio, BWV 248. It consists of six cantatas originally intended for performance on one of the major feast days of the Christmas period. The work saw its first performance in 1734, at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, where Bach occupied the position of cantor. In that very same church the thirty-fourth ‘Thomaskantor’, Gotthold Schwarz, leads the St. Thomas Boys Choir Leipzig and the Gewandhausorchester Leipzig in a performance of Bach’s choral masterpiece. Among the soloists are Dorothee Mields (soprano), Elvira Bill (alto), Patrick Grahl (tenor, Evangelist), Markus Schäfer (tenor, arias), and Klaus Häger (bass). This performance was recorded in 2018.

programme.title: Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra - House of Dreams
programme.desc: House of Dreams is an imaginative concert designed by Alison Mackay. It is a magical journey to the meeting places of baroque art and music by Bach and Handel. The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra, who specialize in historical performance is directed by Jeanne Lamon.

programme.title: Mark Perna - Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Katia Labèque - Shostakovich - Symphony No. 5, Op. 47
programme.desc: As part of a new collaboration with the famous composer of music with repetitive structures Philip Glass, French pianists Katia and Marielle Labèque perform the European premiere of Glass's Concerto for two pianos with the Orchester de Paris. The program continues with Shostakovich's Symphony No. 5 with the Orchester de Paris, directed by Jaap van Zweden, current music director of the Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra and the next musical director of the New York Philharmonic.

programme.title: Andrea Molteni - Berg - Piano Sonata, Op. 1
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Alban Berg’s Piano Sonata in B minor, Op. 1. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano. This performance was recorded at the Verbrugghen Hall of the Sydney Conservatorium of Music, Australia, in 2023.

programme.title: Thomas Zehetmair, Ivan Fischer And Budapest Festival Orchestra - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Matthias Hoffmann And Lisa Ochsendorf - IVC 2021 - Final: Schubert, Hahn, Ullmann a. o.
programme.desc: Bass-baritone Matthias Hoffmann (Austria, 1991) and pianist Lisa Ochsendorf (Germany, 1991) perform ‘Il modo di prender morale’ from Franz Schubert’s Drei Lieder, Op. 83, D. 902 during the final round of the International Vocal Competition 2021 – Lied Duo. This performance was recorded at De Verkadefabriek in ’s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands.

programme.title: Václav Luks And Collegium 1704 - Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 2
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. In this performance at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany, Luks and his Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 2 in F major, BWV 1047. This piece features trumpet, violin, recorder, and oboe solos. Especially outstanding are the high, virtuoso trumpet parts.

programme.title: Samuel Hasselhorn And Daniel Heide - Schubert - Winterreise
programme.desc: Baritone Samuel Hasselhorn and pianist Daniel Heide perform Franz Schubert’s song cycle Winterreise (‘Winter’s journey’). The 30-year-old Schubert wrote this masterpiece in 1827, just a year before his death. Like Schubert’s earlier song cycle Die schöne Müllerin (1823), Winterreise is a setting of the poetry of Wilhelm Müller (1794-1827). In twenty-four songs, we follow a rejected young man on a lonely journey through a frozen landscape. Wandering as a lost soul, tormented by his memories, the man searches for peace. This performance was recorded at Schloss Wörlitz, part of the Dessau-Wörlitz Garden Realm, near Dessau, the birthplace and final resting place of Wilhelm Müller.

programme.title: Lily Maisky - Brahms - Piano Quartet No. 3 in C minor, Op. 60
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in a wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, violinist Tedi Papavrami, violist Lyda Chen-Argerich, cellist Mischa Maisky, and pianist Lily Maisky perform Johannes Brahms’s Piano Quartet No. 3 in C minor, Op. 60.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète
programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career. Only after WWII, Haskil’s fame began to take off and she finally enjoyed international recognition.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Humoreske, Op. 20
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwarz performs Humoreske in B-flat major, Op. 20. Schumann composed the work in 1839 and dedicated it to German-Austrian composer Julie von Webenau. The piece’s title refers to humor as an emotional state. Schumann took his inspiration from German Romantic writer Jean Paul, who defines humor as “an infinity of contrast”, “a setting of the small world beside the great”, and where “a kind of laughter results which contains pain and greatness”. Humoreske is one continuous piece consisting of contrasting sections. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Fabien Caux-Lahalle - Who has stolen the Boléro by Maurice Ravel?
programme.desc: One of the world’s most popular pieces of classical music, Maurice Ravel’s Boléro (1928), was no longer copyrighted as of May 1, 2016. Up to then it had made Ravel and his heirs millions. Ravel died in 1937 and left all he owned to his brother Edouard. Edouard’s death in 1960 unleashed a complex legal battle over the rights, involving among others Edouard’s nurse and her husband. This 2017 documentary gives a fascinating account of what happened to one this iconic piece of music right under the nose of the public. Filmmaker Fabien Caux-Lahalle underpins this investigative story with clips of the Boléro in various guises.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène - Beethoven-String Quartet No. 16, Op. 135
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer’s complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 2 in G major, Op. 18, No. 2; String Quartet No. 16 in F major, Op. 135; and String Quartet No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 131. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 16, 2020.

programme.title: Claudio Abbado - Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: The program is introduced with a short documentation about Schönberg's Pelleas et Melisande, based on a text by Claudio Abbado. Every musical theme relates to a special colour appearing on screen. What has been so remarkable about Abbado’s Mahler performances is that their impact has never been achieved at the expense of the multiple sensitivities, subtleties and extreme sophistication. Together with the world's leading youth orchestra – the Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester (GMJO) – Abbado performs Mahler’s Symphony No. 4 and Schönberg’s Pelleas und Melisande, Op. 5. The Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester was founded in Vienna in 1986, by Abbado’s initiative. The orchestra's high level of artistic quality and its international success have moved important conductors and soloists to work with the ensemble.

programme.title: Paul Goodwin And Conjunto Barroco of the Escuela Reina Sofía - Baroque works by Bach, Muffat and Rameau
programme.desc: Paul Goodwin conducts the Conjunto Barroco of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid in a Baroque music program featuring works by Georg Muffat, J. S. Bach, and Jean-Philippe Rameau. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Sony of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, Spain, on February 8, 2024.

programme.title: philharmonie zuidnederland, Boris Berezovsky And Dmitri Liss - Tchaikovsky - Piano Concerto No. 1
programme.desc: A colourful Christmas concert by the South Netherlands Philharmonic with Tchaikovsky’s famous First Piano Concerto. Chief conductor Dmitry Liss showcases, together with master pianist Boris Berezovsky, a true, Russian spirit. In such a way as to evoke what an American critic had said about one of his previous Tchaikovsky interpretations: “Liss expressed an absolute authority over the orchestra and the audience. He displayed a dialogue with eternity”.

programme.title: Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra And Shaun Smyth - The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra, also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. The ensemble is directed by violinist Jeanne Lamon. In ‘The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres’ they perform music by Monteverdi, Vivaldi, Bach and Handel to a backdrop of high-definition images from the Hubble telescope, NASA and Canadian astronomers. Explore the fusion of arts, science and culture in the 17th and 18th centuries in this imaginative concert commemorating Galileo’s first public demonstration of the telescope. Actor Shaun Smyth narrates a compelling script while the musicians weave in and around a magical stage set by Marshal Pynkoski. Created and scripted by Alison Mackay.

programme.title: Misha Fomin - Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw (2020)
programme.desc: Misha Fomin performed romantic piano works at the Amsterdam Concertgebouw in November 2020. His recital opened with Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Sonatas No. 10 and 15 'Pastoral', followed by works of Frédéric Chopin, Johannes Brahms, and Franz Liszt.

programme.title: Myung-whun Chung, Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, Coro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino And Christiane Karg - Mahler - Symphony No. 2, 'Resurrection'
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, along with two vocal soloists, in this impressive performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 2 in C minor, ‘Resurrection’. Soprano Christiane Karg and alto Claudia Huckle are the soloists. Written between 1888 and 1894, this five-movement symphony is scored for a large orchestra, chorus, and soprano and alto soloists. Mahler explores themes of life, death, and resurrection throughout the symphony. Its first movement resembles a funeral march, while the second, a graceful Ländler, creates a stark contrast with the somber character of the first. The third movement is a Scherzo based on Mahler’s musical setting of ‘Des Antonius von Padua Fischpredigt’ from the collection Des Knaben Wunderhorn. The composer also used another Wunderhorn poem, ‘Urlicht’ (Primal Light), for the fourth movement, incorporating both text and music, sung by the alto. The chorus makes its entrance in the second part of the fifth and final movement with the ‘Resurrection’ chorale. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer, Konzerthausorchester Berlin And Daniel Hope - Homage to Yehudi Menuhin
programme.desc: On 22 April 2016, Yehudi Menuhin would have celebrated his 100th birthday. One of his most famous students - and one of his best friends - is violinist Daniel Hope. For him, Yehudi Menuhin was the reason he become a violinist. At first, his mother became the secretary of Menuhin when Daniel Hoe and his parents moved to London. Hope grew up in Menuhin's house and learned not only to love music, but also to make the violin a part of his life. Playing the violin every day is like walking every day, or drinking and eating. He played with Menuhin some of Bartok's Duos which was, according to Hope, an introduction to Bartok’s extraordinary music. A piece of Bartok had to be part of this program as well as Ravel's Kaddish, the encore Daniel Hope choose when Menuhin conducted his last concert in Düsseldorf. But this concert starts with Elgar's Violin Concerto. Hope plays with the Konzerthausorchester Berlin under the baton of Iván Fischer.

programme.title: Silvia Chiesa - Liszt - Elegies No. 1 and 2 (S. 130 And 131)
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Franz Liszt’s Two Elegies for cello and piano. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: David Radzynski, Franz Welser-Möst And Cleveland Orchestra - Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Violin soloist is David Radzynski. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in February 2023. Strauss, at the age of 34, sparked outrage when he cast himself as the central figure of his tone poem. Generally agreed to be autobiographical, the work contains more than thirty quotations from Strauss's earlier works.

programme.title: The Imperial Ice Stars - Ice Dance: Swan Lake (2015)
programme.desc: The Imperial Ice Stars are an ensemble of 24 world class skaters, holding more than 300 competition medals between them. Praised by critics and audiences alike, they never fail to enchant with creative and powerful story-telling, sumptuous sets, spectacular special effects and opulent costumes. Set to the original score of Tchaikovsky's masterpiece, the Imperial Ice Stars present their 2015 Ice Dance interpretation of Swan Lake, complete with an exhilarating choreography from leading ice director Tony Mercer. “Inspired by my research into Tchaikovsky’s original score and intentions for the story, I wanted to create a more realistic interpretation of this much-loved tale and transpose it onto ice, creating a new art form in the process – ice dance in a full theatrical setting,” the choreographer explains. “I always felt it was a natural fit, to have swans gliding on ice.”

programme.title: London Symphony Orchestra And Michael Tilson Thomas - Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: American conductor Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in an energetic performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's folk-infused Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17. Written in 1872, the work is nicknamed 'Little Russian' as the composer used several folk tunes from Ukraine, then known as ‘Little Russia’. This performance was recorded at LSO St Luke's, London, on May 31, 2021.

programme.title: Francesca Dego, Domenico Nordio And Andrea Bacchetti - Sinding - Serenade in A major, Op. 92
programme.desc: Violinists Francesca Dego and Domenico Nordio and pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform Serenade in A major, Op. 92 by Norwegian composer Christian Sinding (1856-1941). Together with Edvard Grieg, Sinding was Norway’s best-known composer at the turn of the century. Composing in the late Romantic style, Sinding’s oeuvre includes a large number of piano pieces, chamber music, and songs. The composer wrote two serenades for two violins and piano: Op. 56 and Op. 92. His Serenade Op. 92 dates from 1909 and consists, like his other Serenade, of five movements. This performance was recorded at Teatro Comunale Città di Vicenza, Italy, on December 2, 2013.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Chorus And Orchestra of the Teatro Real, Teodor Currentzis, Ekaterina Scherbachenko And Alexei Markov - Tchaikovsky - Iolanta
programme.desc: ‘Iolanta’ and ‘Perséphone’ – A double bill consisting of two stage works that “represent an ideal of beauty, poetry and hope” forms this new production by Peter Sellars in Madrid from the Teatro Real from 2012. In both works, the progression from darkness to light acts as an initiation rite that completely transforms the existential attitude of the leading characters. This broadcast features ‘Iolanta’, a mature composition by Tchaikovsky, which was premiered in 1892. It contains all aspects of the composer’s mastery: beautiful melodies, clear structure, and genuine passion in its many varieties. The Chorus and Orchestra of the Teatro Real are conducted by Teodor Currentzis. The soloists in this production are Ekaterina Scherbachenko (Iolanta), Alexej Markov (Robert), Pavel Cernoch (Vaudémont), Dmitry Ulianov (King René), Willard White (Ibn-Hakia), Vasily Efimov (Alméric), Pavel Kudinov (Bertrand), Ekaterina Semenchuk (Marta), Irina Churilova (Brigita) and Letitia Singleton (Irina Churilova).

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig, Symfonieorkest Vlaanderen And Pascal Amoyel - Grieg's Piano Concerto And Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn’s concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides).

programme.title: Misha Mengelberg - Misha Enzovoort
programme.desc: Misha Mengelberg, the forgetting has begun. He is waiting for a taxi he didn’t call to go to a performance that won’t take place. Dutch composer/pianist and grand duke of jazz Misha Mengelberg (1935) has been submerged in the shadow of dementia, ending his life as a musician.

programme.title: Iván Fischer - Dvořák - Symphony No. 7, Op. 70
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Antonín Dvořák's Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70. The work was completed in March 1885 and premiered one month later in London conducted by the composer himself. With its dramatic and dark style, this symphony stands in stark contrast to the predominantly optimistic tone of Dvořák’s broader oeuvre. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, on January 29, 2021.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birthday, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. His Fantasie in C, Op. 17, was written in 1836. It was revised prior to publication in 1839 and dedicated to Franz Liszt. It is one of Schumann's greatest works for solo piano and a central work of the early Romantic period.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Daniel Harding, Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, Coro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino And Christiane Karg - Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna. At the time, Mozart was busy working on his operas La clemenza di Tito and The Magic Flute. By the time he started on the Requiem, in the fall of that same year, his health was seriously declining. Mozart passed away in December 1791, leaving the Requiem uncompleted. His pupil Franz Xaver Süssmayr completed Mozart’s swan song in the form known today, based on Mozart’s sketches and possibly verbal instructions. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Bernard Haitink - Stravinsky - Le Sacre - II: Le Sacrifice
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink closes with Stravinsky's The Rite of Spring which he wrote in 1913 for Sergei Diaghilev's Ballets Russes. The première caused a lot of sensation and near-riot in the audience because of the avant-garde nature, music and choreography of the piece. The Rite of Spring is now considered as one of the masterpieces of classical music history and has influenced many 20th-century music composers. The encore is Tchaikovsky's Flower Waltz from the Nutcracker.

Avec Gérard, 17 ans, elle va bientôt partager beaucoup plus. Une passion dévorante les unit en effet, qui révulse les parents du jeune homme. Danièle est humiliée, condamnée par la justice. Démolie, elle fait un séjour en maison de repos.
Novembre 2030 : sur le thermomètre au fond de la classe, l'enseignante en sueur lit +48°C. J'arrête hein, on ne va pas faire ce cours, ce n'est pas possible.

programme.title: Locked in my House (15)
programme.desc: Jouduttuaan arvostetun lääkärin pahoinpitelemäksi Caris ottaa asiat omiin käsiinsä etsiessään oikeutta. Mutta mitä lähemmäksi totuutta hän pääsee, sitä vaarallisemmaksi hänen tilanteensa muuttuu.

Hän ei kuitenkaan ole yksin, vaan kohtaa yllätyksekseen hämmentyneen tiedemiehen, joka on ajautunut lähes hulluuden partaalle säteilyn vaikutuksesta ja epätoivostaan löytää muita selviytyjiä. programme.title: Sover Dolly på ryggen? (12)

Hän alkaa pelätä, että lapsi voi periä sperman luovuttajan piirteitä, ja päättää siksi varmistua isästä ja siitä, että tämä on yhtä täydellinen kuin hän kuvittelee. Tämä tapahtuma rohkaisi häntä rikkomaan niin totuttuja sääntöjä kuin uskonnollisia ja yhteiskunnallisia odotuksia. Astridista tuli yksi aikojemme luovimmista naisista: koko maailman tuntema ja rakastama tarinankertoja.
